self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R1 Snow Swan's Finale: each Elemental Skill hit on an opponent grants a stack of Lake-Hued Lament (+8% ATK, 8s, max 3). At 3 stacks the CRIT DMG of the wielder's Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG is increased by 50%. The energy restoration at 3 stacks is not modelled (the evaluator has no energy model). The CRIT DMG half uses stellarconduct_critDMG_, which only reaches hits marked stellarconduct_dmg_ — a Stellar-Conduct rotation. Stellar Swirl is not implemented, so a Swirl-Radiance rotation gets the ATK half only.

source.note: 7.0 weapon, added 2026-08-08 from nanoka 6.7.54 beta data (neither Amber nor GO carry it yet). Base stats derived as init x levels['90'] + last ascension add, the same derivation validated to the cent against 15 existing seed files. Buffs baked at R1 (house convention: 4* at R5, 5* at R1).
